overview.description: The Roundhill BABA WeeklyPay ETF (BABW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly distributions and 1.2x leveraged exposure to the weekly price return of Alibaba Group Holdings Limited stock (NASDAQ: BABA). BABA runs e-commerce platforms such as Taobao, Tmall, AliExpress, logistics services, cloud computing, digital media/entertainment operations. BABW was launched on Oct 23, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
